messages.author: fecbe3dc811bed89
messages.subject: gradient order for createItem
parts:
Hi Phil,

Say, I have 3-point items of customized model with 1 latent trait. What is the correct entry order of the first gradient vector? Suppose x=c(tau1, tau2) and Theta=c(t1,t2). I assume gr(x, Theta) will give a vector:

       x_11        x_12        x_13        x_14        x_15        x_16      x_21        x_22        x_23        x_24        x_25        x_26

where
(x_11,x_13,x_15) for tau1, t1, 3 points;
(x_21,x_23,x_25) for tau2, t1, 3 points;

(x_12,x_14,x_16) for tau1, t2, 3 points;
(x_22,x_24,x_26) for tau2, t2, 3 points;


Is it proper?

Thanks

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: gradient order for createItem
parts:
Not quite, the returned vector must be of the same length as the par input, so it's really the sum across all the gradient/hessian terms given individual Thetas. There's actually an example of this in the createItem documentation now, so feel free to install from the dev version to check it out. Cheers.

Phil
